# Open-Logistics

> Open-Logistics is an SDK for the Shiprocket and Delhivery logistics APIs. It ships a TypeScript SDK on npm plus generated Python and Rust clients, with typed orders, shipments, tracking, rates, serviceability, waybills, labels, and normalized errors.

## Packages

- npm: `open-logistics`
- PyPI: `open-logistics-sdk` (import name `open_logistics`)
- crates.io: `open-logistics`
